title: 1FW6 Built-in Torque Motors — Configuration Manual
locator: Mechanical properties/cooling circuits; mounting and centering instructions; rotor/stator installation forces; cooling connections
notes: Siemens-specific installation and cooling requirements for the 1FW6 family. The manual describes centering fixtures, avoiding stator/rotor contact, strong magnetic attraction during insertion, and cooling circuit requirements. Values and procedures must not be copied to other motor families. PDF is linked only and not archived.
